thread.title: NOTICE OF TRUSTEE'S SALE - NewsBreak

author: Hampshire Review
title: NOTICE OF TRUSTEE'S SALE - NewsBreak
text:
By Hampshire Review ,
14 hours ago NOTICE OF TRUSTEE’S SALE is hereby given pursuant to and by virtue of the authority vested in the Substitute Trustee, Pill & Pill, PLLC, by that certain Deed of Trust dated July 29, 2003, executed by the Borrower, Edward T. Shanholtz, to Vance Golden, the Trustee, of record in the Office of the Clerk of the County Commission of Hampshire County, West Virginia, in Book 345, at Page 406. At the time of the execution of the Deed of Trust, this property was reported to have a mailing address of Route 1 Box 72C, Rio, WV 26755, and, upon information and belief, is now known as 389 Short Mountain Village Dr., Rio, WV 26755. Pill & Pill, PLLC was appointed as Substitute Trustee by an APPOINTMENT OF SUCCESSOR TRUSTEE dated January 2, 2024, of record in the Clerk’s Office in Book 709, at Page 214. The Borrower defaulted under the Note and Deed of Trust and the Substitute Trustee has been instructed to foreclose under the Deed of Trust. Accordingly, the Substitute Trustee will sell the following described property to the highest bidder at the front door of the Courthouse of Hampshire County, in Romney, West Virginia, on the following date: Read full article
